[Erowid Note: 
While it may be that the substance described is pure MDMA, Ecstasy/Molly tablets and powders are notoriously impure, misrepresented, or adulterated. Ecstasy sold in retail contexts such as festivals or parties often contain chemicals other than MDMA.]
First of all I am not a regular user. I have 10 years expirience in various hallucinogenic drugs.
Two days ago, I went out last minute desicion, friends birthday, club with bass. Before reaching the place I drunk half a bottle of water with some remains of mdma, I had the loose effects nothing strange, I was drinking gin as well. After an hour poured some more on the drink.
I was not attached to music like other times. No sweating or stomach upset. No jaws.
I was not attached to music like other times. No sweating or stomach upset. No jaws.
Illusions only, all faces changed shape constantly, things dissapearing and things appearing from shadows! I managed to handle everything with temper. One other time I also had the 3d effects with similar dosage outdoors.
The first years were nothing like now, different high not so many strong visuals. Colour alteration also. I am also passionate to smoke when I have done mdma.
The thing is I have to be very careful BEFORE I take it. Check the enviroment, the people, the surroundings. If I am in a dodgy place the possibilities something bad to happen are many, I dont do it!
I consider support from friends vital!
That day with the cartoon ish effects, it also happened to see people with neon like sunglasses, that is very weird, few other have seen it as well! I dont try rolling, the papers simply dissapear, also the control of fingers is limited. I never carry expensive stuff. I lost two times my phone.
